seal.statement: The partition leader admits a replica (raft ADD of a CREATE_REPLICA/REPLACE target) from an explicit admission request answered from the committed replica operation (operation id, partition, replica identity, target node), never from the target's services row arriving in the leader's CDC-fed SystemTableCache; the committed admission node comes from the operation, not from a row. A routed system-table write answers at commit with its log position; a consumer that needs its own projection waits on that position, ended only by shutdown. Deleted for these decisions: the cache-row admission producer (handleSystemTableCacheChange -> reconcileRaftPeersFromCacheForService -> admitPartitionRaftPeer, its init call and its cache re-read on re-drive) and the cache-visibility wait (waitForCacheUpdate, its 750/250 budget split, the bootstrap bypass, the authoritative repair fallback, allowPendingVisibility). The CDC obligation hold (cdc_committed_acceptance_unknown) and leader-local apply are handed to the CDC D1-D4 owner as a named obligation. On fresh-formation-user-table-routability every replica named by a committed operation is admitted within one request round of its SYNCING commit, with no dependence on cache visibility.

Lead decisions 2026-11-02 for attempt 1: (1) the leader reads the committed replica operation through the partition's getControlPlaneSystemTableGateway readAuthoritativeRows with the success-only rule; a failed read answers AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE (typed, never a create failure). (2) the target sends ADMIT_REPLICA {partitionId, replicaIdentity, operationId} from createReplicaAsync after recordReplicaIdentity (SYNCING commit); while pending it is re-driven on the EXISTING learner-promotion cadence (runLearnerPromotionCheck) - the cadence is reused, no timer is added; the leader re-drives stored requests on CONF_CHANGE_APPLIED/LEADER. (3) the groupRetiringRefusal cache-read fence inside admitPartitionRaftPeer stays as an explicit, reasoned exemption (refuse-only fence owned by the group-retirement owner), named in static test (f). (4) write-answer test 2(c) is a guard that stays green.

R17 finding (not this quest's to fix; owner = sibling quest fresh-create-failure-after-committed-admission): on the Phase 0 run (b26d2c090, 2026-11-02T10:26:07Z) (i) 69 committed services entries failed 'UNIQUE constraint failed: services.service_id' at apply on the seed's services-p1 (Failed to apply committed entry, first 10:29:57.616); (ii) sql_transactions-p1-r4 was shut down at 10:29:57.194 after being admitted and promoted to voter (10:29:57.126) without a committed REMOVE, its create failing on a deferred authoritative replica_operations read in authorizeFreshCreate; (iii) H3' (unproven): the dead voter stays in sql_transactions-p1's committed configuration, so its control release cohort refuses hosted_replica and every later fresh create fails release_fact_unavailable. Settling observation: READ_COMMITTED_MEMBERSHIP of sql_transactions-p1 vs hosted replicas at a hosted_replica refusal instant.
